chapters.role: Prepare for stress, slips, winter/holidays, old friends who smoke

days.title: Day 121: Welcome to chapter six
days.intro: This chapter is not about doubting your progress, it is about making sure you are ready for the genuinely hard days that life still has in store.

tasks.title: Know why this chapter exists
tasks.text: Even strong long term quitters can face serious tests, like grief, major stress, or tough seasons, and preparing for them in advance lowers the risk of a slip.

tasks.title: Set your chapter six goal
tasks.text: Pick one type of hard day you want to feel more prepared for by the end of this chapter.

days.title: Day 122: Defining your worst case
days.intro: It helps to know, specifically, what your hardest possible day might look like.

tasks.title: Describe your toughest scenario
tasks.text: Write a description of the single hardest situation you can imagine facing while staying smoke free.

tasks.title: Write your emergency plan
tasks.text: Write down exactly what you will do if that hardest scenario actually happens, step by step.

days.title: Day 123: Grief and major stress
days.intro: Major life stress, loss, or grief is one of the highest risk situations for relapse, even far into a quit.

tasks.title: Know the grief risk
tasks.text: Major emotional events like loss or grief are linked to relapse even after long smoke free periods, because the urge to cope the old way can return strongly during intense pain.

tasks.title: Build a crisis contact list
tasks.text: Write down two or three people you would reach out to first if you were going through something very difficult.

days.title: Day 124: Seventeen weeks free
days.intro: Seventeen weeks behind you, more than four months of consistency.

tasks.title: Claim your seventeen week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: See your stats so far
tasks.text: Open your stats and review your full progress at this stage.

days.title: Day 125: Preparing for winter
days.intro: Colder months can bring more indoor gatherings, holiday stress, and shorter days, all of which can affect mood and habits.

tasks.title: Think about winter risks
tasks.text: Write about which parts of colder months or holidays might be harder for you specifically.

tasks.title: Plan one winter strategy
tasks.text: Pick one specific plan for handling holiday gatherings or shorter, darker days without smoking.

days.title: Day 126: Old friends returning
days.intro: Sometimes people from your smoking past resurface unexpectedly, a reunion, an old coworker, a returning friend.

tasks.title: Rate this risk for you
tasks.text: Rate how likely it feels that an old smoking friend could reappear in your life soon.

tasks.title: Prepare your reaction in advance
tasks.text: Decide now exactly what you will say or do if an old smoking friend offers you a cigarette unexpectedly.

days.title: Day 127: Eighteen weeks free
days.intro: Eighteen weeks. Another full week of staying ready, not just staying free.

tasks.title: Claim your eighteen week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: See your trend over time
tasks.text: Open your stats and look at how your craving frequency has trended over the past month.

days.title: Day 128: What if you do slip
days.intro: Preparing for a possible slip is not the same as expecting one, it is simply being ready either way.

tasks.title: Revisit your slip recovery plan
tasks.text: Look back at the slip recovery plan you wrote earlier and update it with anything you have learned since.

tasks.title: One slip does not erase your progress
tasks.text: If a slip ever happens, your accumulated health gains and skills do not disappear, the priority is simply getting back to zero immediately.

days.title: Day 129: Loneliness and isolation
days.intro: Feeling isolated or lonely can quietly increase the pull toward old habits.

tasks.title: Notice any isolation
tasks.text: Write honestly about whether you have been feeling isolated or disconnected lately.

tasks.title: Reach out in the community
tasks.text: Post something in the community today, even just checking in, to stay connected.

days.title: Day 130: Nineteen weeks free
days.intro: Nineteen weeks. Roughly four and a half months of steady progress.

tasks.title: Claim your nineteen week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: Rate your overall resilience
tasks.text: Rate how resilient you feel right now compared to chapter one.

days.title: Day 131: Anniversary dates
days.intro: Anniversaries connected to smoking, like the date you used to buy a pack weekly, can carry quiet emotional weight.

tasks.title: Think about meaningful dates
tasks.text: Write about any specific dates or anniversaries connected to your smoking past that might affect you.

tasks.title: Plan around a tough date
tasks.text: If you know of a specific date coming up that might be hard, write down how you will handle it.

days.title: Day 132: Financial stress and smoking
days.intro: Money worries used to be both a reason people smoked for stress relief and a reason they wanted to quit to save money.

tasks.title: See your long term savings
tasks.text: Open your money saved tab and look at the total amount kept since day one as a reminder of the financial upside.

tasks.title: Rate your current financial stress
tasks.text: Rate how much financial stress you are currently feeling, regardless of smoking.

days.title: Day 133: Twenty weeks free
days.intro: Twenty weeks. Five full months of consistency stand behind you now.

tasks.title: Claim your twenty week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: See your five month overview
tasks.text: Open your stats and review your full progress at the five month mark.

days.title: Day 134: Reviewing your whole plan
days.intro: You are well into chapter six. Today is about looking at the whole arc of your journey so far.

tasks.title: Summarize your full journey
tasks.text: Write a short paragraph summarizing your journey from day one through today.

tasks.title: See your full overview
tasks.text: Open your stats and scroll through your entire history from the very beginning.

days.title: Day 135: Handling unexpected stress
days.intro: Not every hard day can be predicted. Today is about your general readiness for the unexpected.

tasks.title: Practice your fastest reset
tasks.text: Use the breathing tool today and notice how quickly it helps you settle, this is your fastest tool for sudden stress.

tasks.title: Rate your readiness for surprises
tasks.text: Rate how ready you feel to handle a sudden stressful event without smoking.

days.title: Day 136: Twenty one weeks free
days.intro: Twenty one weeks of evidence that hard moments do not have to mean smoking again.

tasks.title: Claim your twenty one week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: See your stats at this stage
tasks.text: Open your stats and review your progress so far this chapter.

days.title: Day 137: Tough seasons, not just tough days
days.intro: Sometimes it is not one bad day but a whole stretch, a busy season at work, a hard winter, a string of stressful weeks.

tasks.title: Think about a hard season
tasks.text: Write about a stretch of time, past or upcoming, that tends to be harder for you than a single day.

tasks.title: Tough seasons need a different plan
tasks.text: A hard season often needs more frequent small check ins with yourself rather than one big plan, since the pressure builds gradually instead of all at once.

days.title: Day 138: Checking in honestly
days.intro: Chapter six works best with honest self check ins, not just motivational pushes.

tasks.title: Rate how today went
tasks.text: Rate today honestly, including anything that felt hard.

tasks.title: Address one real concern
tasks.text: If something has been quietly worrying you about staying smoke free, write it down and note one step to address it.

days.title: Day 139: Twenty two weeks free
days.intro: Twenty two weeks. Each one stacks on the last, building a record that is hard to argue with.

tasks.title: Claim your twenty two week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: Write tonight's reflection
tasks.text: Write one sentence about how you feel right now in your journey.

days.title: Day 140: One hundred forty days
days.intro: One hundred and forty days smoke free. You are deep into the final preparation chapter before the guided plan's home stretch begins.

tasks.title: Claim your one hundred forty day badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: See your progress so far
tasks.text: Open your full stats and health overview to see your entire journey across one hundred forty days.

tasks.title: Share an update
tasks.text: Post a short update in the community about where you are in your journey.

tasks.title: Write a quick reflection
tasks.text: Write a sentence or two about how this stretch of your journey has felt.

days.title: Day 141: Ten days left in chapter six
days.intro: Ten more days remain in this chapter before the final stretch of the guided plan begins.

tasks.title: Set a goal for the rest of this chapter
tasks.text: Pick one thing you want to focus on for the remaining days of chapter six.

tasks.title: Know what is ahead
tasks.text: Chapter seven is the final chapter of your guided plan, leading up to your six month milestone and graduation into independent smoke free living.

days.title: Day 142: Reflecting on six chapters
days.intro: You have now nearly completed survival, habit building, social situations, staying strong, identity, and preparing for hard days.

tasks.title: Pick your hardest chapter
tasks.text: Write about which chapter so far felt hardest for you and why.

tasks.title: Pick your proudest moment
tasks.text: Write about the single proudest moment from your entire journey so far.

days.title: Day 143: Tools you no longer need daily
days.intro: Some tools that were essential early on may now be used rarely, and that is a good sign, not a problem.

tasks.title: Rate your current tool usage
tasks.text: Rate how often you currently use the craving toolkit compared to chapter one.

tasks.title: Less use can mean more progress
tasks.text: Needing the craving tools less often is usually a sign of progress, not a reason to worry, though they remain available whenever needed.

days.title: Day 144: Staying humble about risk
days.intro: Even with months behind you, treating every day as worth protecting keeps your guard appropriately up.

tasks.title: Write your ongoing commitment
tasks.text: Write one sentence describing your ongoing commitment to staying smoke free, regardless of how many months have passed.

tasks.title: Long term success stays active
tasks.text: People who stay smoke free long term generally still treat occasional strong cravings seriously rather than assuming they are permanently immune.

days.title: Day 145: Supporting the community at scale
days.intro: With months of experience behind you, your perspective carries real weight for people earlier in their journey.

tasks.title: Write a longer support message
tasks.text: Write a more detailed message of support or advice for someone struggling in the community right now.

tasks.title: Rate how it feels to give back
tasks.text: Rate how meaningful it feels to support others at this stage of your journey.

days.title: Day 146: Five days to the final chapter
days.intro: Chapter seven is close, the final stretch of the structured plan before you graduate into independent maintenance.

tasks.title: Know what graduation means
tasks.text: Graduating the guided plan does not mean the app stops being useful, it means you move from daily structured missions to lighter, long term maintenance support.

tasks.title: What do you want maintenance to look like
tasks.text: Write about what kind of ongoing support you think you will want after the guided plan ends.

days.title: Day 147: Reviewing your badges
days.intro: Looking back at every milestone collected so far is a concrete reminder of consistency over time.

tasks.title: Review your full badge collection
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and look through every milestone you have earned from day one to today.

tasks.title: Pick your favorite badge
tasks.text: Write about which badge meant the most to you and why.

days.title: Day 148: Almost chapter seven
days.intro: Two days remain in chapter six. You have built real readiness for hard days, whether or not they ever fully arrive.

tasks.title: Rate your overall chapter six experience
tasks.text: Rate how prepared chapter six has made you feel for genuinely hard days.

tasks.title: Tie up any loose plans
tasks.text: Review any emergency or hard day plans you wrote this chapter and make sure they still feel solid.

days.title: Day 149: One day before the final chapter
days.intro: Tomorrow opens the last chapter of your guided plan, the stretch that leads to six months free and graduation.

tasks.title: Reflect on chapter six
tasks.text: Write a few sentences about how prepared you feel for hard days compared to when this chapter started.

tasks.title: Look ahead one more time
tasks.text: Chapter seven will focus on maintaining your progress with a lighter weekly focus as you graduate the structured plan.

days.title: Day 150: Ready for hard days, ready for anything
days.intro: One hundred and fifty days. You have not just avoided hard days, you have actively prepared for them. The final chapter is about carrying this forward for good.

tasks.title: Claim your one hundred fifty day badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: See your full chapter six overview
tasks.text: Open your stats and health overview to see your full progress through chapter six.

tasks.title: Write your chapter six summary
tasks.text: Write a short summary of what you learned about preparing for hard days during this chapter.

tasks.title: Look ahead to chapter seven
tasks.text: Read the chapter seven intro and set one intention for your final stretch toward six months free and graduation.

chapters.name: Six months free
chapters.role: Maintain, light weekly focus, graduate the guided plan

days.title: Day 151: Welcome to the final chapter
days.intro: This is the last chapter of your guided plan. The daily load gets lighter from here, because the goal now is maintenance, not building from scratch.

tasks.title: Know how this chapter works
tasks.text: Chapter seven uses a lighter weekly focus instead of dense daily tasks, since by now most of the heavy lifting of quitting is already behind you.

tasks.title: Set your graduation goal
tasks.text: Pick one thing you want to be true about your relationship with smoking by the time you graduate this plan.

days.title: Day 152: This week's focus, routine check
days.intro: A simple check on whether your daily replacement habits are still solid.

tasks.title: Review your core routines
tasks.text: Write down your current morning and evening routines and whether they still feel automatic.

days.title: Day 153: Twenty three weeks free
days.intro: Twenty three weeks. Almost five and a half months.

tasks.title: Claim your twenty three week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

days.title: Day 154: Quick craving check
days.intro: A simple pulse check on where cravings stand now.

tasks.title: Rate this week's cravings
tasks.text: Rate how often, if at all, you noticed a craving this week.

days.title: Day 155: Community check in
days.intro: Staying lightly connected to the community helps even after the daily missions ease up.

tasks.title: Check the community
tasks.text: Spend a couple minutes in the community today, reading or replying to others.

days.title: Day 156: Money milestone glance
days.intro: A quick look at how much your saved money has grown.

tasks.title: See your savings
tasks.text: Open your money saved tab and look at your current total.

days.title: Day 157: Twenty four weeks free
days.intro: Twenty four weeks, a clean six month count by weeks alone.

tasks.title: Claim your twenty four week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

days.title: Day 158: This week's focus, trigger check
days.intro: A light check on whether any old triggers have quietly resurfaced.

tasks.title: Scan for resurfacing triggers
tasks.text: Write about whether any old trigger has felt slightly stronger lately, even faintly.

days.title: Day 159: Health glance
days.intro: A quick look at how your health progress has continued to build.

tasks.title: See your health overview
tasks.text: Open your health progress tab and notice how things have continued improving since chapter five.

days.title: Day 160: One hundred sixty days
days.intro: One hundred and sixty days. Twenty days remain until you graduate the guided plan entirely.

tasks.title: Claim your one hundred sixty day badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: Rate how maintenance feels
tasks.text: Rate how natural staying smoke free feels now compared to needing daily structure.

days.title: Day 161: This week's focus, gratitude
days.intro: A simple moment to notice what quitting has given you, not just what it took away.

tasks.title: Write one thing you are grateful for
tasks.text: Write one specific thing about quitting smoking that you are genuinely grateful for.

days.title: Day 162: Twenty five weeks free
days.intro: Twenty five weeks. The numbers keep climbing quietly in the background of your normal life.

tasks.title: Claim your twenty five week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

days.title: Day 163: Mentorship check
days.intro: A light prompt to keep supporting others as you near graduation.

tasks.title: Help one newer member
tasks.text: Find one person earlier in their journey and offer a piece of encouragement or advice.

days.title: Day 164: This week's focus, identity
days.intro: A quick reminder of how far your sense of self has shifted since day one.

tasks.title: Describe yourself in one line
tasks.text: Write one line describing how you see yourself now in relation to smoking.

days.title: Day 165: Twenty six weeks free
days.intro: Twenty six weeks, exactly half a year by the week count.

tasks.title: Claim your twenty six week badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

tasks.title: See your half year stats
tasks.text: Open your stats and review your full progress at the half year mark by weeks.

days.title: Day 166: Stats glance
days.intro: A quick look at your full numbers as graduation approaches.

tasks.title: Review your full stats
tasks.text: Open your stats tab and look across streak, money saved, and cigarettes avoided.

days.title: Day 167: This week's focus, future planning
days.intro: A light prompt to think about life as a permanent non smoker, beyond this app's guided structure.

tasks.title: Picture life after graduation
tasks.text: Write a few sentences about how you want to maintain your smoke free life once the guided plan ends.

days.title: Day 168: One hundred sixty eight days
days.intro: Twelve days remain until you complete the full guided plan and reach six months.

tasks.title: Claim your one hundred sixty eight day badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this milestone.

days.title: Day 169: Quick check in
days.intro: A simple pulse check as the final stretch begins.

tasks.title: Rate how ready you feel for graduation
tasks.text: Rate how ready you feel to move beyond the structured daily plan.

days.title: Day 170: This week's focus, full circle
days.intro: A reflective prompt looking back at the entire plan you are about to complete.

tasks.title: Write your full circle reflection
tasks.text: Write a few sentences reflecting on your journey from day one to day one hundred seventy.

days.title: Day 171: Nine days left
days.intro: Nine days remain until you graduate the guided plan and reach your six month milestone.

tasks.title: See your progress so far
tasks.text: Open your stats and look at how close you are to the six month milestone.

days.title: Day 172: Community thank you
days.intro: A light prompt to acknowledge the people who supported you along the way.

tasks.title: Thank someone in the community
tasks.text: Send a thank you message to anyone in the community who helped you along your journey.

days.title: Day 173: Seven days left
days.intro: One week remains until you complete the full guided plan.

tasks.title: Rate this final week's confidence
tasks.text: Rate how confident you feel heading into your final week of the guided plan.

days.title: Day 174: Planning your graduation
days.intro: Six days remain. Time to think about how you want to mark finishing the entire guided plan.

tasks.title: Plan your six month celebration
tasks.text: Decide how you want to celebrate reaching six months and finishing the guided plan in six days.

days.title: Day 175: Five days left
days.intro: Five days until graduation. A short reflective prompt as the finish line nears.

tasks.title: Write what graduation means
tasks.text: Write a few sentences about what completing this entire guided plan means to you.

days.title: Day 176: Four days left
days.intro: Four days until you complete every chapter of the guided plan.

tasks.title: Look back at chapter one
tasks.text: Open your history from chapter one and notice how different that version of you felt compared to now.

days.title: Day 177: Three days left
days.intro: Three days. Almost every milestone in this plan now sits behind you.

tasks.title: Rate your full plan experience
tasks.text: Rate your overall experience of the guided plan from day one to now.

days.title: Day 178: Two days left
days.intro: Two days remain. Soon you will officially graduate from structured daily missions.

tasks.title: Write a note for future you
tasks.text: Write a short note to read on a hard day after graduation, reminding yourself why you quit.

days.title: Day 179: One day left
days.intro: Tomorrow is the day, six full months smoke free and the official end of your guided plan.

tasks.title: Look back one more time
tasks.text: Open your full stats and scroll through your entire journey from day one to today.

tasks.title: Write tonight's reflection
tasks.text: Write one sentence about how you feel the night before reaching six months.

days.title: Day 180: Six months free, plan complete
days.intro: One hundred and eighty days. Six full months without a single cigarette, and the complete guided plan finished from start to end. From here, you continue smoke free on your own, with every tool still in your pocket whenever you need it.

tasks.title: Claim your six month badge
tasks.text: Open your badges tab and collect this major milestone, the biggest one in the guided plan.

tasks.title: See your full six month transformation
tasks.text: Open your full stats and health overview to see your entire journey across all six months and every chapter.

tasks.title: Write your graduation letter
tasks.text: Write a letter to your day one self, telling them everything that happened between day one and day one hundred eighty.

tasks.title: Share your graduation
tasks.text: Post in the community that you have completed the full guided plan and reached six months smoke free.
